_comment: F-012 (#34) — scripts/ is 71 files and ~24.7k lines that decide whether the architecture gates pass, plus openapi/enrichments.ts, which defines every request/response contract in docs/api/openapi.json. It was in no tsconfig project and no referenced project's `include` covered it, so `tsc -b` never compiled it and `bun run typecheck` exited 0 over a tree containing a real TS2300. Same strictness as everything else — deliberately NOT a loosened `strict`, which would defeat the point.
